# Psalm 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Upon Aijeleth-ha-Shahar [Doe-of-the-Dawn]. A-psalm of-David.

**2** My-God, my-God, why have-You-forsaken-me? [Why are You] far from-my-salvation, [from] the-words of-my-groaning?

**3** My-God, I-call by-day and-You-do-not answer, and-by-night — and-there-is-no rest for-me.

**4** But-You [are] holy, enthroned [on] the-praises of-Israel.

**5** In-You our-fathers trusted; they-trusted and-You-delivered-them.

**6** To-You they-cried-out and-were-rescued; in-You they-trusted and-were-not put-to-shame.

**7** But-I [am] a-worm and-not a-man, a-reproach of-man and-despised by-the-people.

**8** All who-see-me mock me; they-curl the-lip, they-shake the-head:

**9** "Roll [it] to YHWH — let-Him-deliver-him; let-Him-rescue-him, for He-delights in-him."

**10** For You [are] the-One-drawing-me from-the-womb, making-me-trust upon the-breasts of-my-mother.

**11** Upon You I-was-cast from-birth; from-the-womb of-my-mother my-God [are] You.

**12** Be-not far from-me, for distress [is] near, for there-is-no helper.

**13** Many bulls surround-me; strong-ones of-Bashan encircle-me.

**14** They-open against-me their-mouth — a-lion tearing and-roaring.

**15** Like-water I-am-poured-out, and-all my-bones are-disjointed. My-heart has-become like-wax; it-melts within my-inward-parts.

**16** My-strength is-dried-up like-a-potsherd, and-my-tongue cleaves to-my-palate; and-to-the-dust of-death You-lay-me.

**17** For dogs surround-me; a-company of-evildoers encircles-me — like-a-lion [at] my-hands and-my-feet.

**18** I-can-count all my-bones; they stare, they-look at-me.

**19** They-divide my-garments among-them, and-for my-clothing they-cast lots.

**20** But-You, YHWH, be-not far; my-Strength, hasten to-my-aid.

**21** Deliver my-soul from-the-sword, my-only-one from-the-hand of-the-dog.

**22** Save-me from-the-mouth of-the-lion! And-from-the-horns of-the-wild-oxen You-have-answered-me.

**23** I-will-declare Your-name to-my-brothers; in-the-midst of-the-assembly I-will-praise-You.

**24** You-who-fear YHWH, praise-Him! All-the-seed of-Jacob, glorify-Him! And-stand-in-awe of-Him, all-the-seed of-Israel!

**25** For He-has-not despised and-has-not abhorred the-affliction of-the-afflicted; and-He-has-not hidden His-face from-him; and-when-he-cried to-Him, He-heard.

**26** From-You [comes] my-praise in-the-great assembly; my-vows I-will-pay before those-who-fear-Him.

**27** The-afflicted shall-eat and-be-satisfied; those-who-seek YHWH shall-praise-Him. May-your-hearts live forever!

**28** All the-ends of-the-earth shall-remember and-turn to YHWH, and-all the-families of-the-nations shall-bow-down before-You.

**29** For to-YHWH [belongs] the-kingdom, and-He-rules over-the-nations.

**30** All the-prosperous of-the-earth shall-eat and-bow-down; before-Him shall-kneel all who-go-down to-the-dust — and-he-who-cannot keep-his-soul alive.

**31** A-seed shall-serve-Him; it-shall-be-told of-the-Lord to-the-coming-generation.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **22:2**: Eli, Eli, lama azavtani — Jesus quotes this verse from the cross (Matthew 27:46). The psalm's opening cry became the cry of the Crucified.

- **22:17**: The Hebrew ka'ari (like a lion) vs. ka'aru (they pierced) is one of the most debated textual variants in the Hebrew Bible. The Masoretic text reads 'like a lion,' but many manuscripts and the LXX read 'pierced.'

- **22:19**: Dividing garments and casting lots — fulfilled literally in the Gospels (John 19:23-24). The specificity is remarkable.

— EMET
